evidence.name: Screen field: Pick the field outline style
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Pick the field outline style" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Pick the field outline style
sections.description: Chooses how the field is outlined: a bottom underline under the text, a bottom underline with room for an icon, or a full box around the whole field. A full box reads most clearly as a place to type, while underline styles feel lighter. Your pick here also decides whether the Border Color and Border Width settings actually show.
